Latto said her baby daddy 21 Savage is a 100 millionaire 🤯🤯

Latto had to let everyone know about 21 Savage’s money 😭💸 She called him her “baby daddy” and said, “My baby daddy a 100 millionaire” putting the $100 million figure on his name herself.

21 has built an impressive career with chart-topping albums, major collaborations and a GRAMMY win. American Dream became his fourth consecutive No. 1 album on the Billboard 200 in 2024, following I Am > I Was, Savage Mode II with Metro Boomin and Her Loss with Drake. 📈🔥

He also won Best Rap Song at the 2020 GRAMMYs for “a lot” featuring J. Cole. From “Bank Account” and “Runnin” to “Rich Flex” and “redrum,” his catalog has continued growing across several successful eras.

Latto clearly wanted to give him his credit 😂👏 What’s your favorite 21 Savage project?
